title: rivest-mc: simulation and calibration tools for the Rivest post-calving caribou abundance estimator
description: An independent Python implementation of the Rivest two-phase post-calving abundance estimator, validated against the CRAN caribou package to 1.4e-12, together with Monte Carlo machinery for measuring its bias, RMSE and interval coverage under controlled departures from the random-mixing assumption, and a calibration of the randomness score test for realistic survey sizes. No field data under restriction is included: every input is either simulated or distributed publicly with the caribou R package.
